title: IoT gateway deployment configuration
description: The ONE deployment configuration (deployments.configuration) shared by the UI wizard steps and sent to Kestra as json_data. Render by `x-step` (os-installation | provisioning) and `x-group` (section); `x-secret` fields must be masked and never logged; `x-step: backend` keys are injected by the backend at execution time; `x-step: legacy` keys are ignored placeholders. Validate a single wizard step against the properties of its x-step; the whole document validates once every step is complete. Stack enable flags are required so the stored config is explicit (the playbook treats an ABSENT flag as enabled). Playbook-side contract: iotgw-kestra tasks/preflight.yaml (iotgw-ng task-130).

osInstallation.title: O.S. Installation
osInstallation.description: Used only by the Kestra `install` flow. The backend lifts these two keys to top-level `target_disk` / `openwrt_version` in json_data.

openwrt_version.title: OpenWRT version
openwrt_version.description: OpenWRT release written to the disk (x86_64).

target_disk.title: Target disk
target_disk.description: Block device on the gateway that is WIPED and receives OpenWRT.

__tags__.title: Stacks to run (tags)
__tags__.description: Ansible tags passed to the provisioning run as `--tags`. Empty = every stack (still subject to the enable flags). `ntp` re-renders only /etc/config/system (hostname + NTP). `ssh_ca` must be included (or the list left empty) for SSH-CA enrollment.

iotgw_hostname.title: Hostname
iotgw_hostname.description: Gateway hostname (/etc/config/system, /etc/machine-id; also the Node-RED flows repo name and the MQTT bridge client id).

num_maquina.title: Machine number
num_maquina.description: Machine index used by the uptime-kuma monitors (LOCAL_PREFIX 10.121.10<n>, so only 0–9 produce valid addresses).

root_password.title: Root password
root_password.description: Gateway root password (hashed sha512 on the device). ALSO the code-server (vscode stack) password.

local_ip_address.title: LAN IP address
local_ip_address.description: Gateway address on br-lan (netmask /26 is fixed in templates/network.j2); also DHCP DNS option, MQTT DNAT target, mosquitto listener, plc_sniffer destination.

main_local_dns.title: Main local DNS
main_local_dns.description: Upstream DNS server for `*.<local_domain>` (dnsmasq); also monitored by uptime-kuma.

backup_local_dns.title: Backup local DNS
backup_local_dns.description: Only consumed by the uptime-kuma monitors (observability).

secundary_ntp.title: Secondary NTP server
secundary_ntp.description: Second NTP server (optional). The key keeps its historical spelling; the playbook also accepts `secondary_ntp`.

zerotier_network_id.title: ZeroTier network id
zerotier_network_id.description: NOT consumed by any provisioning task today (templates/zerotier.j2 is orphaned; the play's old `zeroter_network_id` default was removed). Kept so existing configs round-trip.

zerotier_secret.title: ZeroTier secret
zerotier_secret.description: NOT consumed by any provisioning task today (see zerotier_network_id).

dhcp_hosts.title: DHCP static leases
dhcp_hosts.description: Static DHCP leases on the LAN (uci dhcp host, leasetime 24h).

deploy_shared_ssh_key.title: Deploy shared SSH key (break-glass)
deploy_shared_ssh_key.description: Copies credentials/id_rsa to /root/.ssh (task-073: break-glass only). Keep false.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.description: Rewrites /etc/config/firewall (zones lan/wan/docker/vpn, ManagementIPs + AllowedInternet ipsets) and installs bridge-nft. Enables the `firewall` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

allowed_internet.title: LAN hosts allowed to reach the Internet
allowed_internet.description: Entries added to the AllowedInternet ipset (match src_ip).

management_cidrs.title: Management networks
management_cidrs.description: Entries added to the ManagementIPs ipset (web UIs: LuCI, Dockge, Node-RED, Duplicati, VSCode, Alloy, GLPI, ttyd).

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Writes /etc/config/credentials (uci) with the GHCR PAT and Notion API key. Enables the `credentials` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

ghcr_pat.title: GHCR personal access token
ghcr_pat.description: ghcr.io token (uci credentials.ghcr; also the `docker login ghcr.io` of the glpi-agent stack).

obs.title: Observability
obs.description: Grafana Alloy (metrics+logs via OAuth2 remote write), containers exporter and uptime-kuma/autokuma. Enables the `observability` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

kuma_exporter_username.title: Uptime-kuma exporter username
kuma_exporter_username.description: Alloy scrapes uptime-kuma /metrics with these credentials.

uptime_kuma_port.title: Uptime-kuma port
uptime_kuma_port.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

autokuma_username.title: Uptime-kuma admin user
autokuma_username.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly. Must match the admin account inside the stack's pre-seeded data_clean.tar.gz.

autokuma_password.title: Uptime-kuma admin password
autokuma_password.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly. Must match the pre-seeded data_clean.tar.gz admin account.

mqtt_username.title: MQTT monitor username
mqtt_username.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly. Used by the MQTT monitors (local mosquitto + factory broker).

mqtt_password.title: MQTT monitor password
mqtt_password.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

mqtt_hostname.title: MQTT hostname (DNS monitors)
mqtt_hostname.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

mqtt_port.title: MQTT port (monitors)
mqtt_port.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

factory_mqtt_host.title: Factory MQTT host (monitor)
factory_mqtt_host.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

factory_gw_host.title: Factory gateway host (ping monitor)
factory_gw_host.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

iiot_server_host.title: IIoT server host (ping monitor)
iiot_server_host.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

internet_dns.title: Internet DNS (monitor)
internet_dns.description: Optional uptime-kuma/autokuma knob. If omitted, files/stacks/uptime/env.j2 falls back to a LEGACY client-specific default — set it explicitly.

mqtt.title: MQTT (mosquitto + EMQX bridge)
mqtt.description: Local mosquitto broker bridged to the IIoT EMQX broker; ensures the bridge user exists in EMQX. Enables the `mosquitto` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

emqx_api_key.title: EMQX API key
emqx_api_key.description: EMQX API key id (Basic auth user).

iiot_host.title: IIoT broker address
iiot_host.description: Bridge `address` (host[:port]) of the upstream EMQX broker.

iiot_mqtt_user.title: IIoT bridge user
iiot_mqtt_user.description: Created/updated in EMQX's built-in database; used as the bridge remote_username.

mqtt_bridge_topics.title: Bridge topics
mqtt_bridge_topics.description: Full mosquitto `topic` directive arguments, one per entry (pattern direction qos), e.g. `site/line/5/# both 0`.

users.title: Local MQTT users
users.description: Users added to the local mosquitto password file (mqtt stack).

glpi-agent.title: GLPI agent
glpi-agent.description: GLPI inventory agent container (pulled from ghcr.io with ghcr_pat). The key is hyphenated like the tag; `glpi_agent` is accepted by the playbook as an alias. Enables the `glpi-agent` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

duplicati.title: Duplicati backups
duplicati.description: Duplicati container with two imported backup jobs (Docker data, system). Enables the `duplicati` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

duplicati_docker_target_url.title: Docker backup target URL
duplicati_docker_target_url.description: Duplicati target URL — embeds the backup backend credentials, hence secret.

duplicati_system_target_url.title: System backup target URL
duplicati_system_target_url.description: Duplicati target URL — embeds the backup backend credentials, hence secret.

telegraf.title: Telegraf
telegraf.description: Telegraf container that loads its config from InfluxDB. Enables the `telegraf` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

nodered.title: Node-RED
nodered.description: Node-RED with a per-gateway flows repo (github.com/<github_org>/flows.<iotgw_hostname>). KNOWN BROKEN: the stack's data/.config.projects.json.j2 and SSH deploy key are not vendored in iotgw-kestra, so preflight fails while this is on. Enables the `nodered` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

nodered_password.title: Node-RED admin password
nodered_password.description: Hashed with bcrypt on the gateway.

github_org.title: GitHub org of the flows repo

netxms.title: NetXMS agent
netxms.description: NetXMS agent container; also opens tcp/4700 from netxms_server_ip in the firewall. Enables the `netxms` stack. The playbook runs it only when this is not false AND its tag is selected (`__tags__` empty = all tags). When false, the stack's fields are not required.

netxms_master_servers.title: NetXMS master servers
netxms_master_servers.description: Comma-separated addresses allowed to control the agent.

iotgw_ip.title: Gateway management IP (informational)
iotgw_ip.description: From the Ansible-Forms era (inventory host). NOT used by the provisioning flow: the target is the device's Netmaker address, injected by the backend as `target_ip`.

iotgw_ssh_ca_base_url.description: INJECTED BY THE BACKEND at execution time (executeKestraDeployment) — never stored in or edited through the deployment configuration. Kong base URL of the ssh-ca edge function.
